scope: Primary-source verification for the static variational transport follow-up. No historical-priority claim.

sources.title: Introduction to Homogenization Theory, Lecture 1
sources.author: Grégoire Allaire
sources.verified: Full primary-author PDF accessed. Periodic potential-energy characterization is stated for bounded uniformly positive definite conductivity. The text allows discontinuous coefficients.
sources.used_for: Context for the positive-contrast periodic cell tensor. The follow-up proves the zero-contrast cell limit directly and does not borrow a degenerate homogenization theorem.
sources.not_claimed: Interchange of contrast and homogenization limits; Brownian invariance principle.

sources.title: Regularized homogenization on irregularly perforated domains
sources.verified: Full primary research PDF accessed. The paper treats analytical difficulties from irregular geometry and states a variational formulation for its stochastic setting.
sources.used_for: Boundary between a direct static cell-energy argument and additional homogenization obligations. No theorem from the stochastic model is applied to the periodic Vitruvian domain.

proof_ingredients: Finite-energy convolution currents, distributional periodic divergence, Cauchy-Schwarz, an explicit periodic corrector, Hilbert-space projection and a direct infimum limit argument are derived in THEOREM.md.
